description: This line plot illustrates how BLEU scores vary with the length of the gold prefix, comparing two scenarios labeled “Inconsistency: wait-9” and a baseline condition. The x-axis represents “the length of gold prefix,” ranging from 0 to 20 in integer increments, with tick labels appearing at each integer value. The y-axis represents BLEU scores, ranging from 23 to 29, with major gridlines and tick labels at integer intervals. The baseline condition is depicted by a blue dashed line with open circle markers, starting at a BLEU score of approximately 24.5 at x=0, rising to about 28.0 at x=20. The “Inconsistency: wait-9” condition is shown by an orange solid line with square markers, beginning at a BLEU score of 25.0 at x=0, fluctuating between approximately 25.0 and 26.0 across the x-axis range, and ending at approximately 25.8 at x=20.
